notes.title: Nominate Metal: Hellsinger VR in The Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Hey there, Hellsingers!

It's been almost two months since we released Metal: Hellsinger into the wild and took you on the most immersive demon-slaying experience the nine hells have ever seen.

We are at that time of the year again, with The Steam Awards beginning, giving you the chance to celebrate your favorite video games on a slightly bigger scale.

We are glad to see that you're having fun slaying to the beat with our one of a kind metal baby, and we'd love it if you could nominate us for the VR Game of the Year award on this year's event. 

If you have your doubts about Metal: Hellsinger VR and wanna try the game before you vote, we actually still have a demo that you can play right here on the game's Store page. We also put the game on sale as a part of the Steam Autumn Sale. Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2878270/Metal_Hellsinger_VR/

You can vote for Metal: Hellsinger VR [url=https://www.thegameawards.com/nominees/best-vr-ar]by clicking on this link[/url] and helping us take this epic trophy to Hell.

The non-VR version of Metal: Hellsinger is also 67% off, with DLCs 25% off. 

You can catch a new 3-hour livestream every day of the event [url=https://www.saveandsound.io/]here [/url], showcasing some of the best music from across the industry. notes.title: Becoming Unknown - Metal: Hellsinger VR | High Score Contest
notes.notes:
Greetings Hellsingers,

Last week, we casually dropped the demo for Metal: Hellsinger VR and we hope that you have been enjoying your time in VR Hells.

[h2][b]Let's spice things up a little, shall we?
[/b][/h2]
We are organizing a high-score contest. It's simple. 

- Launch the demo
- Select [b]Stygia - Goat[/b] difficulty - Keep it the default song
- Slay to the beat
- Get the highest score and record your gameplay showing the start and the end screens clearly
- Share your gameplay video on X, Facebook, TikTok, or Instagram with the hashtag #BecomingUnknown and your name on Steam. You can also upload it to YouTube and share the link on socials. Up to you!
- Stay at the top of the leaderboard and win

We have a [b]leaderboard[/b] in the game so you can follow your progress in real time and see how close you are to getting the highest score. You also shouldn't use the Beat Assist Mode!

[h2][b]What about the rewards?
[/b][/h2]

There will be 3 winners.

[b]1st place:[/b] Cameo video from [b]Matt Heafy[/b] of [b]Trivium[/b] and a [b]Metal: Hellsinger VR[/b] key for platform of choice
[b]2nd place:[/b] Metal: Hellsinger VR key for platform of choice
[b]3rd place:[/b] Metal: Hellsinger VR key for platform of choice

Do you have what it takes? Then start working on your demon-slaying game because [b]this contest will be active only until July 17th. [/b]

Time is ticking, Hellsinger. Show them what you're made of.

Note: The entries are going to be curated by our community team and if we notice any exploits or anything suspicious like that, we will have the right to disqualify your entry.

notes.title: Metal: Hellsinger VR FAQ
notes.notes:
Hellsingers! 

After listening to your most asked questions, we put together this FAQ to make sure you’re not in the dark. Please let us know if you think we missed anything important though! 

[b] Q: Is Metal: Hellsinger VR going to have new content? [/b] 

Metal: Hellsinger VR is going to have the same content as the base game plus post-launch features like Torment challenges, beat assist mode, and the Archdevil difficulty mode. The Leviathan mode will not be included. 

[b] Q: Do owners of Metal: Hellsinger get Metal: Hellsinger VR for free? [/b] 

The Steam version of Metal: Hellsinger VR will be sold at a discounted price if you already own the game. You will have to purchase the VR version separately on other platforms. 

[b] Q: When Metal: Hellsinger VR arrives, is it going to be compatible with every VR headset? [/b] 

Metal: Hellsinger VR will officially support Quest 2, Quest 3, PSVR2, HTC VIVE and Valve Index. It will also run on Quest Pro, although there won’t be a specific version for it. For other brands and models, you will have to try it out yourself.  

[b] Q: Is Metal: Hellsinger VR going to have the DLCs of the main game? [/b] 

We will have some of the DLCs available to purchase at launch. We’ll share more about this soon. 

[b] Q: How is the game being adapted to VR? Is it just the same game from a VR PoV? [/b] 

Metal: Hellsinger VR is being balanced and carefully rebuilt with its high-octane gameplay in mind. Combining this with the innovative gameplay style of VR, we’re aiming to create a unique but still familiar experience. Every weapon will feel very different to use.  The Unknown’s Lair is a brand-new feature which will act as a hub area where you can rest between levels and plan your next gig. We’re also improving the game’s UI and UX elements for better quality of life options. 

[b] Q: Are there going to be motion sickness and/or accessibility options? [/b] 

Yes, Metal: Hellsinger VR is going to have beat assist and the core UI picker from the base game. It will also include: 

Strong/soft vignettes 
Snap/continuous turning 
Turning speed adjustment 
Head vs hand directional movement 
Turn on/off UI elements 
Beat indicator position choice 
Aim assist 
Automatic weapon pumping/Manual weapon pumping 
Height calibration – supports standing and seated play 
Left hand support 
 
[b] Q: Is teleporting supported? [/b] 

Metal: Hellsinger VR only has the smooth locomotion movement type.  
 
[b] Q: What are the system requirements for Metal: Hellsinger VR?[/b] 

[b] Minimum PC [/b] 
64-bit Processor 
OS: Windows 10 
Processor: Core i5-7500 / Ryzen 5 1600 
Memory: 12GB Ram 
Graphics: GTX 1060 / RTX 580 - 6B VRAM 

[b] Recommended PC [/b] 
64-bit Processor 
OS: Windows 10 
Processor: I7-7700 / Ryzen 5 3600 
Memory: 16GB RAM 
Graphics: RTX 2080 
Network: Broadband

notes.title: Metal: Hellsinger is coming to VR!
notes.notes:
Hellsingers! 

Did you think the music had stopped? Hells, no! We’re proud to announce Metal: Hellsinger VR, coming to Steam in 2024! 

[previewyoutube=sqwqHF9S-v4;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready to be fully immersed in metal and mayhem. Step into the body of the Unknown in full VR and become a true demon of vengeance. Wield her full wicked arsenal in your very hands and unleash its power straight into the snarling hordes’ ugly faces.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016301/93f6bde1297b8f276650a3cc427570315bca9e33.png[/img]
Metal: Hellsinger VR includes everything you’ve come to know and love in Metal: Hellsinger. That means the full award-winning soundtrack performed by your favorite metal legends, and the entire campaign to wreak vengeance upon the Red Judge all in glorious VR. 

The game has been rebuilt to take full advantage of the strengths of VR, creating accurate and meaty gunplay, a world that pulsates to the beat, and doing away with most menus for an immersive hub area. Aim dual pistols independently, cock your shotgun, and make them fear the beat. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016301/fe2f9841e2cb05bfb1158ad62c2f8a8d2b063b8b.png[/img]
Whether you want to physically move around yourself, use the joystick, standing or even seated, Metal: Hellsinger VR will deliver delicious heavy metal carnage straight into your ears and eyes. 

[b]The game is coming to Steam in 2024. [/b]

We’ll have a lot more to show you before then, so get your necks ready; headbanging is always recommended, but we take no responsibility for projectile VR sets. 

Stay on beat, Hellsingers 🤘 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38016301/a378cfc8d7754f773e5c6f0975ae9bf97a4870fc.png[/img]
